addition.item: ⁠A welcome page in the « Plugin » tab of the settings: version, presentation, links to the manual, support and download.
⁠On this page, the « Joomanji updates » box lists the pending updates of your Joomanji products, with an « Update all » button. Joomla does the update.

change.item: ⁠The settings move to the « Settings » tab. The editor’s Settings button leads straight there.

addition.item: ⁠Visible line breaks (purple ↵): split into paragraphs (Ctrl+Shift+Enter), join with the previous paragraph (Shift+Backspace).

change.item: ⁠The block list opens in the middle of the window.
⁠A block’s gear counts its changed settings, marked in purple in the panel.

note.item: ⁠Requires Joomla 6.2 or newer. Nothing to set again.

addition.item: ⁠First public version of Markus Editor: a block editor replacing TinyMCE (paragraphs, headings, lists, quotes, images, tables, columns, modules and more).
⁠Markdown can be typed straight in; pasted Markdown becomes blocks; open and save a .md file.
⁠Paste cleaned up from Word, Google Docs or LibreOffice; clean HTML, which TinyMCE reads back as is.
⁠Accessibility checked while writing, spelling with LanguageTool, footnotes, article outline.
⁠The Joomla and extension buttons (Article, Image, Menu, Opus, Iris, Formulus) work as they did with TinyMCE.

note.item: ⁠Joomla 6.2 and PHP 8.3 minimum. Free. You can go back to TinyMCE at any time.
